questions.question_text: Why is a day-before checklist important for a school event like a dance or talent show?

options.text: It helps you avoid doing any work on the event day itself
It ensures all details, like team roles and vendor arrivals, are confirmed to prevent last-minute chaos
It guarantees that nothing will go wrong during the event
It’s only necessary if you’re planning an outdoor event

correct_answer.text: It ensures all details, like team roles and vendor arrivals, are confirmed to prevent last-minute chaos

questions.question_text: What is a good way to manage the event schedule during a school fundraiser if an activity runs late?

options.text: Ignore the delay and hope no one notices
Cancel the rest of the activities to save time
Use a backup plan like playing music or hosting a quick game to fill the gap while keeping the crowd engaged
Tell everyone to leave early since the schedule is off

correct_answer.text: Use a backup plan like playing music or hosting a quick game to fill the gap while keeping the crowd engaged

questions.question_text: How can you handle a problem like low turnout at your school’s movie night event?

options.text: Focus on making the smaller crowd feel special by hyping up the energy and rearranging the space to feel full
Cancel the event since not enough people showed up
Ignore the attendees and focus only on cleaning up early
Refuse to let anyone else in to keep it exclusive

correct_answer.text: Focus on making the smaller crowd feel special by hyping up the energy and rearranging the space to feel full

questions.question_text: What is an effective way to ensure guest satisfaction at a school talent show?

options.text: Avoid talking to attendees so they can focus on the performances
Greet guests warmly, plan interactive moments like contests, and check on their comfort with access to water and rest areas
Only focus on the performers and ignore the audience
Make the event as short as possible so guests don’t get bored

correct_answer.text: Greet guests warmly, plan interactive moments like contests, and check on their comfort with access to water and rest areas
